sentences.japanese: 彼女は面と向かって夫を罵った。
sentences.english: She called her husband names to his face.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は私を馬鹿だの何だのと罵った。
sentences.english: She called me a fool and what not.

sentences.japanese: 彼らは声の限りに罵りあった。
sentences.english: They were swearing at each other at the top of their voices.
